title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1971-02-24

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a Pigpen‑driven party show with scorching Hard to Handle, epic Good Lovin', rare King Bee and a wild Truckin > NFA > GDTR > NFA sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that sounds very crisp, though the treble is a touch high. Musically the night is a high‑energy “Pigpen” showcase – Hard to Handle sizzles, an extended Good Lovin' shines, a rare King Bee and a soaring Lovelight lift the house, and the Truckin/NFA/GDTR/NFA segue is unforgettable.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the performance and note good (though slightly treble‑heavy) soundboard quality; one lower rating tempers enthusiasm, yielding an overall strong but not unanimous endorsement.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very crisp with a slight treble boost; clear and listenable without being shrill.

standout_songs: Truckin > Not Fade Away > Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad > Not Fade Away
show_quality.setlist_flow: Party‑like atmosphere with a fiery first set and a second set that builds to an exhilarating Truckin/NFA/GDTR/NFA sequence, keeping the momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ and vocals are loose and energetic, driving many of the night’s highlights.
